title: Catering
intro: Select from a list of top-notch caterers to support all special events. Food options range from plated to fast casual to meet everyone's event needs.

sections.heading: Catering Services
sections.markdown:
MCCS offers several venues throughout the installation to host your next special event.

Choose from beachfront, lake views, and large event center. [View Event Centers.](https://pendleton.usmc-mccs.org/dining-entertainment/event-planning-multimedia/event-planning/event-centers)
